name: agent-dev
description: Develop and extend existing agents — add skills, memory systems, GitHub Issues development workflow (backlog, roadmap, groom, claim, autoplan, commit, sprint, work-loop — standalone skills the add-backlog installer copies), cross-actor project management (project-init / project-task / project-steward / project-reconcile / project-intake — standalone skills the add-project-management installer copies; both families are mirrored into the trinity-skills library for assignment on Trinity), long-running multi-stage pipelines (add-pipeline + heartbeat / status / recover / pause / resume runtime skills), system-aware orchestration (add-orchestrator — discover / compose / orchestrate a multi-agent system via Trinity's SystemManifest), a shared canonical-data layer (add-canon — a fleet canon repo with publish / consume / reconcile / doctor runtime skills and per-counterpart relations memory; add-canon-lint — deterministic consistency linting of the canon repo: two-zone schema, one-home-per-key facts, CI on every push), and fleet analysis + migration (agent-fleet-analysis — scan directories of agents in any paradigm, score fleet maturity / migration readiness, recommend a fleet architecture, map every gap to an installable marketplace skill, and emit a PDF report plus an agent-executable markdown work order; agent-fleet-migrate — execute that work order non-destructively: copy sources into a fresh workspace, extract logic per paradigm (n8n nodes / framework code / freeform prompts), delegate every fix to a named marketplace skill, verify each copy through the review gate, and report the before/after maturity delta with a gated Trinity deploy offer)
